title: Privacy Preference Center
generalParagraph1: Chai Shots uses cookies to deliver the best possible streaming experience, personalize content, and keep your account secure.
generalParagraph2: You can choose which optional cookies to allow while still keeping essential platform functions enabled.
essentialParagraph: These cookies are essential for security, authentication, and playback and cannot be disabled.
essentialItemDescription: Required for authentication, security, and uninterrupted playback.
performanceParagraph: Performance cookies help us improve speed, reliability, and your app experience.
performanceItemDescription: Helps us optimize playback, language preference, and responsiveness.
analyticsParagraph: Analytics cookies let us understand usage patterns and improve recommendations.
analyticsItemDescription: Collects anonymous viewing and engagement data for product improvements.
advertisingParagraph: These cookies deliver more relevant promotions and marketing content.
advertisingItemDescription: Supports ad personalization and campaign measurement.
